key_concepts: Solutions are formed from a solute and a solvent
Concentration expresses the amount of solute in a given solution
Percent by volume concentration equals volume of solute divided by volume of solution time
Solute and solution volumes must use the same units
Volume of solute can be calculated from percent concentration and solution volume
Percent mass by volume concentration equals mass of solute divided by volume of solution t
A 75% disinfectant label means 75 ml of solute is present in 100 ml of solution
A 1000 ml solution labeled 75% alcohol contains 750 ml of alcohol
A 5% vinegar in 100 ml contains about 5 ml acetic acid and 95 ml water
A 355 ml wine labeled 12% ethyl alcohol contains 42.6 ml ethyl alcohol
Laboratory solution preparation requires measuring solute amount and using appropriate vol
Prepared solutions should be labeled with name, concentration, and date
